en-US.author: XK72 Ltd
en-US.longDescription: Charles is an HTTP proxy / HTTP monitor / Reverse Proxy that enables a developer to view all of the HTTP and SSL / HTTPS traffic between their machine and the Internet. This includes requests, responses and the HTTP headers (which contain the cookies and caching information).
en-US.name: Charles Proxy
en-US.releaseNotes:
Minor new features & improvements
- Transaction warnings: Charles now adds warnings to a transaction when it finds a problem (such as a remote server’s SSL certificate has expired). Warnings show in the Overview tab and in a new Warnings column in the session table, which is hidden by default. Charles saves warnings in .chlz session files.
- SSL Proxying: When Charles cannot complete the SSL handshake with the remote server, the client now receives a 502 Bad Gateway error page that explains the failure instead of a broken response.
- SSL Proxying: Improve reporting of SSL failures
Bug fixes
- Windows and Linux: In 5.2.1 and 5.2.2, Export Settings and Profiles left out the settings from various tools and importing those settings did not work.
- Session table: Adding or removing a custom column no longer resets the order and visibility of your columns.
- Find: Fixed an error in the Find dialog when you clear the session or remove transactions while results show.
- SSL Proxying: fixed some suppressed Charles certificate rejection errors

zh-CN.description: 网络调试代理应用程序
zh-CN.longDescription: Charles 是一款 HTTP 代理/HTTP 监视器/反向代理，可让开发人员查看其机器与互联网之间的所有 HTTP 和 SSL / HTTPS 流量，包括请求、响应和 HTTP 标头（包含 cookies 和缓存信息）。
